title: AGY 1.0.2: -p/--print mode outputs nothing to stdout on Windows

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear and actionable bug report describing how -p/--print mode outputs nothing to stdout on Windows 11. It includes environment details, reproduction steps, expected vs actual behavior, log evidence, and potential root cause context.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: This is a platform-specific issue involving stdout stream buffering and flushing during non-interactive execution on Windows. Per effort guidelines, platform-specific bugs and non-interactive stdio/stream issues require cross-environment testing and validation, qualifying as MEDIUM effort.

summary.problem: Running the CLI in non-interactive print mode (-p/--print) on Windows outputs nothing to stdout, even though the API call succeeds and generates content.
summary.root_cause: In non-interactive mode on Windows, output written through TextOutput and createWorkingStdio proxies is buffered or delayed without explicit stream flushing or proper stdio proxy handling when stdout is not a TTY.
summary.context: Log files confirm the model output is received and processed, but non-TTY stdout stream operations on Windows fail to emit or flush the buffered text prior to CLI process termination.

steps: Inspect stdio creation in packages/core/src/utils/stdio.ts to ensure writeToStdout and working stdout proxies correctly flush output on Windows non-TTY streams.
Update TextOutput in packages/cli/src/ui/utils/textOutput.ts to handle non-TTY stdout streams and enforce immediate flushing where applicable.
Ensure non-interactive execution flows in packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.ts and packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCliAgentSession.ts complete all pending stdout writes before exiting.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: CLI non-interactive print mode (-p/--print) writes model output to stdout and flushes the stream completely before process exit on Windows and non-TTY environments.
verification_steps: Add unit test cases in nonInteractiveCli.test.ts that mock non-TTY stdout streams.
Assert that response content sent to textOutput is written to stdout during non-interactive execution.
Verify stdout contains expected model response text upon completion.
